participation.context: Wrote the opening, and stopped before the how.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set them talking in the heat. You wrote that you know he must go, and that you have known it since the book, and that you do not know how. You stopped while he was still talking.

title: Began the street while the talker went on

participation.context: Wrote the line, and left the how off it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put the heat, the street, and the talker on the tables, and you stopped.

title: Wrote hot day, the street again, the talker
